title: MoJE: Mixture of Jailbreak Experts, Naive Tabular Classifiers as Guard for Prompt Attacks
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and benchmarking of a guardrail architecture (MoJE) specifically designed to detect and mitigate jailbreak attacks on Large Language Models. While it mentions ethical standards as a motivation for safety, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a primary component of the study.
